name: Villanueva del Pardillo (Spain)
description: Golden yellow field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villanueva del Pardillo (a tree and grapes on white and a bend with the words AVE MARIA).
history: On 7 November 1997 the agreement officially fixing the heraldic arms and flag of the municipality was published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado; the flag is of proportion 2:3, a golden yellow cloth.

features.role: Villanueva del Pardillo arms — tree and grapes on white, bend with the words AVE MARIA
